title: Ceramics Classes with Raku and Gas Reduction Firing
source_quote: Our students enjoy ceramics classes and workshops that utilize raku, electric oxidation, gas reduction, sodium vapor, and wood-fueled firing techniques.
evidence_sentence: The ceramics page states students take classes using raku firing techniques.
evidence_quote: utilize raku, electric oxidation, gas reduction, sodium vapor, and wood-fueled firing techniques
summary: Worcester Center for Crafts offers ceramics classes that use raku firing. Winter 2027 registration opens November 4, 2026, but specific class dates and titles are not listed on these pages.
how_to_join: Register through the online course catalog at register.worcestercraftcenter.org
